sentiment.rationale: IBM reported a strong Q1 with revenue up 6% constant currency, operating pretax margin expanding 140 bps, and free cash flow up 13% to a decade-high Q1 level. Management raised software growth guidance from 10% to '10-plus percent' and reaffirmed full-year constant currency revenue growth of 'more than 5 percent' and free cash flow growth of 'about $1 billion'. The guidance raise is organic, driven by software acceleration and Confluent closing early, not FX. However, management explicitly chose not to raise overall revenue or FCF guidance, citing prudence after only one quarter, which caps the score below +0.5. The tone is confident but measured, with no material risks disclosed.

summary.revenue: $15.9 billion, up 9% as reported, up 6% at constant currency.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations $1.28, up 14% year-over-year. Operating (non-GAAP) diluted EPS $1.91, up 19% year-over-year.
summary.guidance: Full-year 2026: constant currency revenue growth of more than 5%; free cash flow to increase by about $1 billion year-over-year; software growth raised to 10-plus percent; operating pretax margin expansion of about 1 point; operating tax rate in the mid-teens.
summary.margin: GAAP gross profit margin 56.2%, up 100 bps; operating (non-GAAP) gross profit margin 57.7%, up 110 bps. GAAP pre-tax income margin 8.7%, up 80 bps; operating pre-tax income margin 13.4%, up 140 bps. Adjusted EBITDA margin 25.0%, up 170 bps.
key_risks: Potential energy impacts in Europe if straits remain closed (speculative, not yet material).
Currency headwinds from geographic mix affecting consulting margins.
Dilution from Confluent acquisition (stock-based compensation and interest expense) expected to absorb about $600 million in 2026.
Higher cash taxes, higher CapEx, and higher net interest expense as headwinds to free cash flow.
key_opportunities: AI tailwinds across all segments: software AI revenue exceeding $1.5 billion, growing over 40% annually.
Red Hat OpenShift surpassing $2 billion in ARR; virtualization contracts exceeding $600 million since early 2024.
Confluent acquisition expected to contribute over 15 points to data revenue growth (projected 20%-25% for the year).
Mainframe Z17 cycle: first-year hardware placement value up over $1 billion vs prior cycle, with 3x-4x software/services stack multiplier expected.
Productivity savings of $4.5 billion since 2023, with an additional $1 billion expected in 2026.
Consulting GenAI backlog penetration at about 30%, with 80% of GenAI consulting from net new clients.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Arvind Krishna stated 'the first quarter was a strong start to the year' and 'we remain confident in our ability to sustain revenue growth of 5% plus and grow free cash flow by about $1 billion this year,' while CFO James Kavanaugh described 'a strong start to the year' and 'we feel confident in our outlook.'

review_flags.reason: Score of 0.30 is above the 0.15 BUY threshold but below 0.5 because management did not raise overall revenue or FCF guidance despite a strong Q1. The software guidance raise is organic, but the overall guidance is reaffirmed. A reviewer may consider whether the software raise alone justifies a higher score.
